races.name: Hong Kong Jockey Club World Pool Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict:
A typically-competitive opener to the week, with preference for COROLLA POINT who confirmed his previous promise this season with a determined success at Hamilton last time, form boosted by the third winning since. The main danger could be Toca Madera after his unlucky fifth in the Stewards Cup, with Lexington Blitz and Naana's Sparkle completing the shortlist.

  1. COROLLA POINT (IRE)
  2. TOCA MADERA (IRE)
  3. LEXINGTON BLITZ (IRE)

races.name: Tattersalls Acomb Stakes (Group 3)
races.verdict:
HAFFNER continued his theme of race-by-race progress when finishing a very good second in Group 2 company at Glorious Goodwood 3 weeks ago and appealing as the type to progress further, Aidan O'Brien's colt makes plenty of appeal. Impressive Galway scorer Trean is another intriguing contender for the Paddy Twomey yard and shouldn't be underestimated, with Confucius and Gentle Hurricane completing the shortlist.

  1. HAFFNER (USA)
  2. TREAN (IRE)
  3. CONFUCIUS (IRE)

races.name: Sky Bet Great Voltigeur Stakes (Group 2)
races.verdict:
A cracking renewal of the Great Voltigeur Stakes. PIERRE BONNARD made an underwhelming start to his 3-y-o campaign but turned in easily his best effort when 2 lengths third of 8 in the Irish Derby at the Curragh on his latest outing and is weighted to reverse the form with Derby-winning stablemate Christmas Day. Maltese Cross, a progressive and most likeable son of Sea The Stars, did well to get himself out of a tight spot to land the Grand Prix de Paris and is an obvious player, too.

  1. PIERRE BONNARD (IRE)
  2. CHRISTMAS DAY (IRE)
  3. MALTESE CROSS (FR)

races.name: Juddmonte International Stakes (Group 1)
races.verdict:
A much-anticipated clash between OMBUDSMAN, Timeform's highest-rated horse in Europe, and Constitution River, who established himself as the best middle-distance 3-y-o around with his smooth win in the Eclipse. The latter looks capable of even bigger performances but Godolphin's superstar is still taken to become the first back-to-back winner of this since Halling 30 years ago. Item has landed a pair of Group 2 wins over C&D this year and may prove best of the remainder.

  1. OMBUDSMAN (IRE)
  2. CONSTITUTION RIVER (FR)
  3. ITEM

races.name: Sky Bet Stayers Handicap (Heritage Handicap) (GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
A competitive valuable staying handicap. Preference is for KIRCHNER, who took another step forward for his new yard when bolting up at Ascot last month and James Owen's 4-y-o is fancied to make light of a 6 lb rise with the booking of Ryan Moore only enhancing his claims further. Small Fry heads up the dangers having run as well as he ever has at Goodwood recently, with Boatswain and Valedictory another couple worth considering, too.

  1. KIRCHNER (IRE)
  2. SMALL FRY (IRE)
  3. BOATSWAIN

races.name: Irish Thoroughbred Marketing Handicap (Heritage Handicap)
races.verdict:
This is wide open. SCHRODINGER'S CAT just missed out to Naana's Shadow over C&D in June and didn't enjoy the rub of the green behind that rival at Goodwood so looks the way to go on these much more advantageous terms. Katie Scott's improving filly still rates a big threat despite an 8 lb hike in the weights, while handicap debutant Zain Primus, Manatee Mehmas and Underwriter also need factoring into this very open sprint.

  1. SCHRODINGER'S CAT
  2. NAANA'S SHADOW (IRE)
  3. ZAIN PRIMUS

races.name: Sky Bet Nursery
races.verdict:
HENLEY ON THAMES looked suited by the step up to 6f when making all in maiden company at Hamilton at the beginning of the month and looks on a favourable mark for his nursery debut. Dubai Champion went very close in a similarly competitive nursery at Glorious Goodwood and rates an obvious threat. The Dancing Pirate and Sovereign Glory are others who shaped well in that same Goodwood contest and are also shortlisted along with God Given Talent, an interesting recruit for William Haggas.

  1. HENLEY ON THAMES (IRE)
  2. DUBAI CHAMPION (IRE)
  3. THE DANCING PIRATE

races.name: Sligo Plumb Centre Mares Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
COTSWOLD BLUE is taken to build on last month's Wexford bumper success and make a winning start to her hurdling career for Willie Mullins. Belladaball is the likely danger if none the worse for her fall at Cork.

  1. COTSWOLD BLUE (FR)
  2. BELLADABALL (IRE)
  3. SEARCOG (IRE)

races.name: Aidan Moffitt Memorial Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
FREMANTLE DOCTOR ran a cracker when runner-up on his recent return at Ballinrobe and with this unlikely to take much winning, John McConnell's 8-y-o gets the nod to open his account. Granlahan has been placed 4 times in handicaps this season, so he can give the selection most to think about, with Tasmanian Girl rounding off the shortlist.

  1. FREMANTLE DOCTOR (IRE)
  2. GRANLAHAN (IRE)
  3. TASMANIAN GIRL (IRE)

races.name: Solar Generation Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict:
KISUTON ENKI travelled best when second at Limerick on her hurdling debut in April and, after a couple of runs in bumpers, she could be ready to open her account. Seven Towers is best forgiven his latest effort and is feared most, with Mindyourheadmike also considered on his hurdles bow.

  1. KISUTON ENKI (FR)
  2. SEVEN TOWERS (IRE)
  3. MINDYOURHEADMIKE (IRE)

races.name: McDermott Farm Machinery Handicap Hurdle (0-100)
races.verdict:
PHOENIX ARIZONA has improved on the back of a stable switch of late, finding only one too good over shorter here 2 weeks ago. He can confirm recent promise and shades preference over Sekakarma who also found only one too good latest. Last-time-out scorer Laska du Breuil and El Arco on debut for Gordon Elliott are others to consider.

  1. PHOENIX ARIZONA (IRE)
  2. SEKAKARMA (IRE)
  3. LASKA DU BREUIL (FR)

races.name: Francie 'Banger' Burns Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Cases can be made for most of these, but the vote goes to HARPY EAGLE, who was suited by a strong pace when opening his account at Wexford 11 days ago and he could well kick on now up and running. In The Minus caused a shock when scoring here earlier in the month so he rates as the main danger if able to back that up, with In For The Night and Coolboy Christy taken to fight out minor honours.

  1. HARPY EAGLE (IRE)
  2. IN THE MINUS (IRE)
  3. IN FOR THE NIGHT (IRE)

races.name: Adare Manor Opportunity Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
Loads with chances but STRONG CONTENDER was dominant when shedding the maiden tag in clear-cut style at Wexford 12 days ago, going right away in the closing stages in the style of one capable of better again. She earns preference over Sallap and Hey Babbs. Cornmarket and Ilbdare both go well here and can also feature in a competitive heat.

  1. STRONG CONTENDER (IRE)
  2. SALLAP (IRE)
  3. HEY BABBS (IRE)

races.name: WTW Willis Insurance Brokers Flat Race
races.verdict:
Willie Mullins has already sent out 5 bumper winners this month and RUN FOR FUN is taken to provide him with a sixth by making a winning debut. Dancing Symbol is clear pick of those with experience having finished runner-up to a stablemate of the selection on her recent debut at Wexford. Orderly Conduct makes most appeal of the remainder with the longer trip sure to suit.

  1. RUN FOR FUN (FR)
  2. DANCING SYMBOL (IRE)
  3. ORDERLY CONDUCT (IRE)

races.name: NXT Big Thing Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
GUADALEVIN ran her best race when sixth of 8 in a listed contest at Sandown on her latest outing, even with things not going her way, and she looks to hold leading claims back in novice company. The biggest threat could come from Diamond New Bay, who can step forward from her first run, with Ma Blushin Rosie one to note on debut.

  1. GUADALEVIN (IRE)
  2. DIAMOND NEW BAY (IRE)
  3. MA BLUSHIN ROSIE (IRE)

races.name: Kingmoor Park Properties Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
races.verdict:
She may have failed to progress from her winning debut last time but ALEATRIX is fancied to quickly get back on the up at the expense of 5-y-o Peace Belle, who seemed to excel herself in the face of a seemingly impossible task when third in the Silver Cup at York last month.

  1. ALEATRIX
  2. PEACE BELLE
  3. GREEN AREA

races.name: North Lakes Energy - Harry Doyle Memorial Maiden Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
Ruth Carr has her team in form so it may be worth chancing her new recruit FATE'S GAMBIT, who is nicely handicapped on his peak form in Ireland. Fellow 3-y-o Long Shot is second choice. April Diamond could also have a say if recapturing the level of her course handicap debut second.

  1. FATE'S GAMBIT (IRE)
  2. LONG SHOT
  3. APRIL DIAMOND (IRE)

races.name: North Lakes Energy - Harry Doyle Memorial Maiden Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
HEY HAVANA has been knocking on the door and is taken to gain reward for his consistency. Supreme Dancer is another who has shown he can be very competitive at this level and is feared most ahead of Fionn McSharry's Danrana.

  1. HEY HAVANA (IRE)
  2. SUPREME DANCER (IRE)
  3. DANRANA (IRE)

races.name: David Allen IT Solutions Handicap
races.verdict:
MISUNDERSTOOD has been shaping up quite well in recent starts and may prove the answer to this competitive handicap. Commander of Life, Golden Strike, Son and Native Instinct head the many dangers.

  1. MISUNDERSTOOD (FR)
  2. COMMANDER OF LIFE (IRE)
  3. GOLDEN STRIKE (IRE)

races.name: Armstrong Watson Handicap
races.verdict:
YELLOW DIAMONDS shaped quite well tackling 6f for the first time at Thirsk recently and is given a chance to build on that promise. The return to 6f looks ideal for Hares Bredth who may provide the main threat ahead of Maximum Velocity, who had a possible excuse when behind the selection last time.

  1. YELLOW DIAMONDS (IRE)
  2. HARES BREDTH
  3. MAXIMUM VELOCITY (IRE)

races.name: Knights Handicap
races.verdict:
Several with possibilities in this finale. Low-mileage 3-y-o KEEP AN EYE ON IT should have more to offer on the back of last week's Ayr success and is narrowly preferred to Ephron, Hostility, who is bidding to make it 3-3 in C&D handicaps this summer, and Between Me And U.

  1. KEEP AN EYE ON IT
  2. EPHRON (IRE)
  3. HOSTILITY (IRE)

races.name: Unibet Interactive Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The market should prove revealing but the vote goes to WITHTEARSINMYEYES who holds the edge on form and returns from a break with Billy Loughane an eye-catching booking. Merry rates a big threat on the back of a very good Wolverhampton handicap second, while Marco Botti's new recruit Graniteville and debutants Mile End Road and Palliser are interesting also.

  1. WITHTEARSINMYEYES (IRE)
  2. MERRY
  3. GRANITEVILLE (IRE)

races.name: Unibet 3 Uniboosts A Day Nursery
races.verdict:
Stall 13 will test the skills of Toby Moore but BEACH AHEAD looks a very interesting contender on second nursery start with 7f sure to suit. Kochella finished ahead of the selection when they met over 6f here 2 weeks ago and she's a solid rival, with Printing Money a potential improver after a gelding operation.

  1. BEACH AHEAD
  2. KOCHELLA (IRE)
  3. PRINTING MONEY (IRE)

races.name: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
ALGAIHABANE hails from a top yard and this Royal Lodge entrant is taken to make a winning debut at the chief expense of form pick Thunder Home, who should have won at Sandown 4 weeks ago. Other newcomers Shaddock and Perfect Heir make appeal, while Newcastle scorer Sonic Angel must be in the reckoning also.

  1. ALGAIHABANE
  2. THUNDER HOME (IRE)
  3. SHADDOCK

races.name: Unibet More Extra Place Races Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FEELIN' FREE shaped well when runner-up on her debut at Ffos Las in June and with that form having been franked she is taken to go one better back from a break. The James Owen-trained duo Lucy The Wire and Bankatary appeal as the main dangers in that order.

  1. FEELIN' FREE
  2. LUCY THE WIRE (IRE)
  3. BANKATARY (FR)

races.name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (Div 1)
races.verdict:
A few with chances but it could be worth siding with LAKE COMO who is a dual winner on the all-weather and returns after a break (also gelded) on a handy-looking mark. Hat-trick seeking Victory Ace rates a big threat stepping back up to 1m, with Darn Hot Gallop also of interest back on an artificial surface. Recent course scorer Percy's Lad also commands plenty of respect.

  1. LAKE COMO (IRE)
  2. VICTORY ACE
  3. DARN HOT GALLOP

races.name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (Div 2)
races.verdict:
RACINGBREAKS RYDER did well to score over 7f here last time given he was drawn widest of all and from a much more advantageous berth this front runner can defy a penalty and complete a hat-trick. Elan d'Or and Captain Fox should both benefit from the return to 1m and could be the dangers.

  1. RACINGBREAKS RYDER (IRE)
  2. ELAN D'OR
  3. CAPTAIN FOX (IRE)

races.name: Unibet 40,000+ Live Streamed Events Handicap (Div 3)
races.verdict:
CAVOLO NERO ended his time for James Ferguson on the up with success at Yarmouth and is taken to make the perfect start for Harry Eustace having been nudged up just 2 lb. Recent Lingfield scorer Malachy's Wish is next on the list under a penalty, although handicap debutant Rogue Defence and last year's winner Port Road also need factoring in.

  1. CAVOLO NERO
  2. MALACHY'S WISH
  3. ROGUE DEFENCE

races.name: Try Unibet's New Smartview Racecards Handicap
races.verdict:
OBSIDIAN VERSE didn't enjoy the rub of the green when sixth at Wolverhampton last time so is fancied to capitalise on a lenient-looking mark and double his tally. Santiago Boy is feared most on the back of an improved second behind a thriving winner here last week, while Piazza and Slack Bob can't be discounted either in an open handicap.

  1. OBSIDIAN VERSE
  2. SANTIAGO BOY
  3. PIAZZA

races.name: CopyBet BOG Now For York Tomorrow Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MUSKERRY ROCK was in command some way out when scoring at Newton Abbot 5 weeks ago and can win again. Smugglers Haven could be the danger back over fences having been in good form over hurdles.

  1. MUSKERRY ROCK (IRE)
  2. SMUGGLERS HAVEN (IRE)
  3. HARRYS HOPE (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Pay First Past The Post Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
MR MCWHINNY was well on top when making his second start for Tom Ellis a winning one at Market Rasen last month and he looks one to follow. He can go in again. Alshadhian was second in this race last year and could be set for a big run in first-time cheekpieces, while Turpin Gold may have a bigger effort in him over fences.

  1. MR MCWHINNY (IRE)
  2. ALSHADHIAN (IRE)
  3. TURPIN GOLD

races.name: CopyBet Support Safer Gambling Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SPARKLING WATER looked much improved when making a winning start for Dan Skelton at Uttoxeter last month and sure to be well prepared for this switch to hurdling, she'll take some stopping. Datstheholyallofit also won a bumper last time so she commands respect, while Take The Boat is likely to give her running.

  1. SPARKLING WATER
  2. DATSTHEHOLYALLOFIT (IRE)
  3. TAKE THE BOAT (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet For Premier League Profit Boosts Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Plenty of depth to this novice with HANDMEDOWNASTAR selected to continue on the up having joined a stable going places since his Fontwell win. Road To Wembley is feared most, despite the fact that Sean Bowen has presumably elected to ride fellow hat-trick seeker Newbrook Diamond instead.

  1. HANDMEDOWNASTAR (IRE)
  2. ROAD TO WEMBLEY
  3. NEWBROOK DIAMOND (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
races.verdict:
STARSHINE LEGEND will need to improve on what he's displayed so far over hurdles but this trip may well be the catalyst on handicap debut for his leading yard. Mrs Biddle is an interesting runner for new connections, who turn to Harry Cobden, while Warner's Cross ought to remain competitive.

  1. STARSHINE LEGEND (IRE)
  2. MRS BIDDLE (IRE)
  3. WARNER'S CROSS (IRE)

races.name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Handicap Hurdle (Div 2)
races.verdict:
ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY was a beaten favourite on stable debut when fourth of 8 at Warwick in May, but he offered some encouragement by the finish and promises to be suited by this return to further. He gets the vote ahead of Crafty Gael, who could also fare better making second start for his current yard, with Bannister another one to note.

  1. ONEHUNDREDNEIGHTY (IRE)
  2. CRAFTY GAEL (IRE)
  3. BANNISTER (FR)

races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
THE GREAT ESCAPE has saved his very best for this venue, capitalising on a much-reduced mark when successful over C&D 5 weeks ago. A token 2 lb rise doesn't look insurmountable and he rates a big player again. Fellow C&D winner Mancero is similarly compiling a solid course record and is a threat, with Redbridge Rambler another to note back over hurdles.

  1. THE GREAT ESCAPE (IRE)
  2. MANCERO (FR)
  3. REDBRIDGE RAMBLER (IRE)

Prix De L'hippodrome De San Sebastien Stakes

Poule D'essai 12.5 - Trophee Anglo Show-prix Century 21 Duprat & Associes Stakes

Prix De La Besbre Maiden Stakes
